arguments.value: This amendment extends the wireless content license agreement by keeping the listed properties licensed through March 31, 2008, while other rights under the agreement otherwise expired on December 31, 2006. It also updates the licensee notice details by changing the contact title to General Counsel and removing the old email address. All other terms of the original agreement remain in effect.
